primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Source-supported benchmark candidates are more actionable when converted into axis-specific absorption targets with forbidden shortcuts and claim boundaries.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude creates a no-provider target queue before implementing or claiming any architecture absorption from high-star OSS candidates.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: README content is a primary project source for positioning and usage signals.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude uses README-derived signals only as internal target-selection evidence, not as public validation.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Repository contents help classify source/manifests before implementation-pattern absorption.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude requires root source or manifest evidence before prioritizing architecture absorption targets.

selfImprovementActions: Prioritize newly discovered source-supported projects for scoped architecture reviews.
Defer metadata-only candidates until source/manifests are proven by stronger evidence.
Map every absorption target to product-quality axes before any implementation work.
Keep protected actions and public/readiness/superiority claims blocked until explicit authorization and stronger evidence exist.
